meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, April 30th, 2025 in Community and Protective Services Committee Report 17.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, April 16, 2025, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thursday, April 17, 2025.
.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Public Safety Service 2024 Annual Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes: At the outset, Mr. Ryan Perrault, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD), introduced Ms Beth Gooding, Director, Public Safety Service, EPSD, who spoke to a slide presentation overview of the report.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.  Following questions to the presenter, the report recommendation was put before Committee and was ‘Carried’, as presented.

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee recommend Council receive the Public Safety Service 2024 Annual Report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Ottawa Fire Services 2024 Annual Report

attachments.attachment_title: English Document 1 - OFS 2024 Annual Report Data.pdf
French Document 1 - OFS 2024 Annual Report Data.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Mr. Ryan Perrault, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD) introduced Ottawa Fire Services (OFS) Chief Paul Hutt who, in turn, introduced Ms Louise Hine-Schmidt, Deputy Chief, Operations, OFS, and Ms Colleen Woolsey, Deputy Chief, Community Standards and Communications, OFS.  All three spoke to a slide presentation which served as an overview of the OFS Annual Report.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.  Mr. Pierre Poirier, Chief, Ottawa Paramedic Service, was also present to respond to questions
Following questions to the presenters, the report recommendation was put before Committee and was ‘Carried’, as presented.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee recommend that Council receive the 2024 Ottawa Fire Services Annual Report for information.
